title: Dim Sum Steamed Dumplings
description: Delicate and flavorful steamed dumplings filled with a savory mixture of beans, pinto beans, and spices, inspired by traditional Chinese cuisine.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine mashed pinto beans and beans.
Add sweet, chinese, and yummy (if using) to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Wrap the mixture in a wonton wrapper, forming a half-moon shape.
Place the dumpling on a steamer basket, leaving space between each dumpling.
Steam the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve immediately with a side of pickle slices for garnish.
Serve with a drizzle of soy sauce or your favorite dipping sauce.
Enjoy as a snack or appetizer, or as a side dish for a Chinese-inspired meal.
